lines.text: Dusk. The sun has almost fully disappeared into the horizon.
She is away from the VHF radio when she notices a ship on the radar, getting too close to the island in silence.
This is (lighthouse name), do you copy? Please state your vessel name. I repeat, this is (lighthouse name), please state your vessel name. Over.
Copy, (lighthouse name), this is the Sul Mare radio officer. Over.
You are rapidly approaching (island name). Please state your current speed and coordinates. Over.
Copy that. The (lighthouse name) is (coordinates). Please state your present activities near these waters. Over.
We are conducting whaling operations approximately five nautical miles from your coordinates. Over.
Understood. How long do you intend to remain in the area? Over.
Approximately seven days, weather permitting. Over.

choice.text: We would like to confirm whether your vessel holds a valid commercial whaling permit for operations in these waters. Over.

lines.text: Affirmative, our vessel is operating under an authorized commercial whaling license. Over.
Could you provide your permit number for our records? Over.
Please hold while we consult the captain. Over.
(lighthouse name), thank you for standing by. Our permit number is NZ-IWC-251197-082. Over.
Received, thank you for your cooperation. (lighthouse name), over and out.
